BayesRays.mechanism: Post-hoc spatial deformation of both density/color query coordinates, RGB Jacobian/Fisher and diagonal local Laplace approximation. Metric deformation coordinates can come from existing encoder/IMU poses and K; this is different from ray termination width or feature tracking.
BayesRays.inputs: Differentiable frozen field and training cameras. Official implementation computes Jacobian-based quantity without observed RGB residuals. Inference has no new metricrange observation.
BayesRays.output: Spatial sensitivity/epistemic uncertainty; prior/noise/coordinate conventions matter. No direct evidence here of a calibrated absolute centimetre error interval or pose/modelbias coverage.
BayesRays.comparison_plan: Same fixed camera/ray sample and two frozen wrong/qualified fields; first check observed-data stationarity in an admissible deformation direction. Only if assumptions/units supported would a separately frozen uncertainty-field comparison use postsealed target/error labels to test wrong-vs-qualified ordering. No filtering or rescue of v99.
BayesRays.result: One-direction observed-RGB stationary-centre condition contradicted in both fields/aggregations. No Hessian/variance/interval calculated. This rejects treating these centres as justified observed-data posterior modes, not fullBayesRays uncertainty ranking/performance.
BayesRays.implementation_identity: Official adapter supports Nerfacto/NGP/MipNeRF; local scalar diagnostic is not an installed/fullBayesRays adapter. No dependency install or model download.

GURecon.mechanism: Extract SDF roots/normals, tangent-plane patch homography, top-four SSIM inconsistency and continuous3D uncertainty distillation; extra view-dependent fields handle illumination.
GURecon.difference: Continuous3D surface-root/patch uncertainty target differs from the old LK feature roundtrip and triangulation. Its measurement still uses posed multi-view image consistency; learning a head does not itself create a new range reference.
GURecon.inputs: A reconstructed SDF surface and normals, calibrated posed RGB; per-scene distillation. Current surface fields were analytic engineering references, not GT-free reconstructed RGB surfaces; old closed densityfields have no qualified SDF root contract.
GURecon.output: A photometric consistency-derived score, not a calibrated metre interval in current domain. Cannot declare surface point or localpatch agreement to be zero depth uncertainty.
GURecon.comparison_plan: Would require a legitimate GT-free reconstructed surface/root extraction, fixed causal view set and complete independent pseudo-label coverage before fit; later score wrong/qualified surface geometries under identical predeclared metric calibration. Those prerequisites are absent; no root threshold/normalGT substituted.
GURecon.result: No executable standalone metric-error contract in the current repair. No implementation, distillation, model fit or performance evaluation. Official main listing checked contains project readme/assets; no training code used.

conclusion: No new calibrated metric uncertainty or GT-free RGB surface measurement has been admitted; current surface/uncertainty repair continuation ends. Do not infer all sensors/methods impossible or that the two papers failed performance tests.
